column1: # experiments.tsv - every setting of the local-model experiments on Vulcan, and the resources its job asks for.
# One line = one setting = one job (plus its successors, if the time limit ends it early): vulcan/submit.sh reads this file.
#   scenario  1.1 name only | 1.2 name + Microsoft docs  (one reply, no repository)      -> wine_bench
#             2.1 name + source tree | 2.2 the same + Microsoft docs  (agent in the tree) -> wine_agent
#   workers   oneshot: requests in parallel;  agent: tasks in parallel (= tree pairs on the node's local disk)
